# ==============================================================================
# Setup and Toggles
# ==============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(xts)
library(zoo)
library(ggplot2)
library(ranger)
library(yardstick)
library(glmnet)
library(tempdisagg)
library(vip)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidytext)

ddir <- file.path(getwd(), "data")
wdir <- getwd()
set.seed(123)

# ---- Toggles ----
INCLUDE_BES       <- FALSE   # BES starts 2008 Q2 — toggling off extends panel back to 2000
INCLUDE_CES       <- FALSE   # CES ends 2020 Q4; only useful for pre-break modelling
INCLUDE_CALL_RATE <- FALSE   # Call_Rate is ~62% NA across the panel
BES_START_DATE    <- as.Date("2008-04-01")  # only used when INCLUDE_BES = TRUE

# ---- Savings/interest rate column toggles ----
INCLUDE_SAVINGS_RATE  <- TRUE
INCLUDE_TD_7D         <- FALSE   
INCLUDE_TD_1M         <- FALSE
INCLUDE_TD_3M         <- TRUE    # representative short-end
INCLUDE_TD_6M         <- FALSE
INCLUDE_TD_12M        <- TRUE    # representative long-end
INCLUDE_TD_OVER12M    <- FALSE
INCLUDE_PRIME_LENDING <- TRUE
INCLUDE_MAX_LENDING   <- TRUE

# ---- Google Trends toggle ----
INCLUDE_GT      <- FALSE   # FALSE = macro-only model (longer panel, back to 1999)
GT_PRESCREEN    <- FALSE   # drop near-constant / mostly-zero keyword series
GT_MIN_NONZERO  <- 0.50    # keep a keyword only if >=50% of quarters are non-zero
GT_TOP_K        <- NA      # NA = keep all that pass

# Master flag switch
INCLUDE_FLAGS <- FALSE

# Individual flag toggles (only effective when INCLUDE_FLAGS = TRUE)
FLAG_BES_GAP           <- TRUE   
FLAG_BES_CADENCE       <- TRUE   
FLAG_CES_GAP           <- TRUE   
FLAG_METHODOLOGY_BREAK <- TRUE   

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Load Data
# ==============================================================================

qtr_to_month <- c("Q1" = 1, "Q2" = 4, "Q3" = 7, "Q4" = 10)

to_qstart <- function(year, period) {
  period <- as.character(period)
  out <- as.Date(rep(NA, length(period)))
  is_q <- period %in% names(qtr_to_month) # Fixed typo here (%in%)
  is_m <- period %in% month.abb          # Fixed typo here (%in%)
  out[is_q] <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", as.integer(year[is_q]), qtr_to_month[period[is_q]]))
  m <- match(period[is_m], month.abb)
  q_first <- ((m - 1) %/% 3) * 3 + 1
  out[is_m] <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", as.integer(year[is_m]), q_first))
  out
}

# --- File 1: CPI (Monthly Levels Saved First) ---
cpi_raw <- read.csv(file.path(ddir, "monthly_CPI.csv"))
cpi_dates <- make_date(cpi_raw$Year, match(cpi_raw$month, month.abb), 1)
cpi_monthly_level <- xts(as.numeric(cpi_raw$Monthly_CPI), order.by = cpi_dates) |> setNames("CPI_Level")

# --- File 2: Savings & Interest Rates (Monthly) ---
sav_raw <- read.csv(file.path(ddir, "savings_rate.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
sav_dates <- make_date(sav_raw$year, match(sav_raw$month, month.abb), 1)
sav_xts <- xts(sav_raw %>% select(-year, -month), order.by = sav_dates)
colnames(sav_xts) <- c("Savings_Rate", "Call_Rate", "TD_7d", "TD_1m", "TD_3m",
                       "TD_6m", "TD_12m", "TD_over12m", "Prime_Lending", "Max_Lending")

sav_toggles <- c(
  Savings_Rate  = INCLUDE_SAVINGS_RATE,
  Call_Rate     = INCLUDE_CALL_RATE,
  TD_7d         = INCLUDE_TD_7D,
  TD_1m         = INCLUDE_TD_1M,
  TD_3m         = INCLUDE_TD_3M,
  TD_6m         = INCLUDE_TD_6M,
  TD_12m        = INCLUDE_TD_12M,
  TD_over12m    = INCLUDE_TD_OVER12M,
  Prime_Lending = INCLUDE_PRIME_LENDING,
  Max_Lending   = INCLUDE_MAX_LENDING
)
keep_cols <- names(sav_toggles)[sav_toggles]
sav_xts <- sav_xts[, keep_cols]

# --- File 3: GDP (Annual → Quarterly via Denton-Cholette) ---
gdp_raw <- read.csv(file.path(ddir, "GDP_Nigeria.csv"))
gdp_annual <- ts(gdp_raw[, 2], start = min(gdp_raw$INDICATORS), frequency = 1)

# Smooth baseline Denton-Cholette interpolation
td_gdp <- td(gdp_annual ~ 1, to = "quarterly", method = "denton-cholette", conversion = "average")
gdp_q_vals <- as.numeric(predict(td_gdp))
gdp_q_index <- seq(as.Date(sprintf("%d-01-01", min(gdp_raw$INDICATORS))), by = "3 months", length.out = length(gdp_q_vals))
gdp_q <- xts(gdp_q_vals, order.by = gdp_q_index) |> setNames("GDP_constant_2010")

# --- File 4: BES (Mixed Quarterly/Monthly) ---
if (INCLUDE_BES) {
  bes_raw <- read.csv(file.path(ddir, "BES_data.csv"), fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
  bes_raw$qdate <- to_qstart(bes_raw$Year, bes_raw$Period)
  bes_raw$is_monthly_obs <- bes_raw$Period %in% month.abb

  bes_q <- bes_raw %>%
    filter(!is.na(qdate), qdate >= BES_START_DATE) %>%
    group_by(qdate) %>%
    summarise(
      BES_Employment_Outlook = mean(Employment_Outlook_Index, na.rm = TRUE),
      BES_monthly_cadence    = as.integer(any(is_monthly_obs))
    ) %>%
    arrange(qdate)

  if (INCLUDE_FLAGS && FLAG_BES_CADENCE) {
    bes_xts <- xts(bes_q[, c("BES_Employment_Outlook", "BES_monthly_cadence")], order.by = bes_q$qdate)
  } else {
    bes_xts <- xts(bes_q[, "BES_Employment_Outlook", drop = FALSE], order.by = bes_q$qdate) |> setNames("BES_Employment_Outlook")
  }
}

# --- File 5: CES (Quarterly) ---
ces_raw <- read.csv(file.path(ddir, "CES_data.csv"), fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
ces_raw$qdate <- to_qstart(ces_raw$Year, ces_raw$Quarter)
ces_xts <- xts(ces_raw$Unemployment_Expectation_Index_Next_12_Months, order.by = ces_raw$qdate) |> setNames("CES_Unemp_Exp_12m")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Convert Monthly Sources to Quarterly (With Correct Level Aggregation)
# ==============================================================================

to_quarterly_mean <- function(x) {
  ep <- endpoints(x, on = "quarters")
  q  = period.apply(x, INDEX = ep, FUN = colMeans, na.rm = TRUE)
  m <- as.integer(format(index(q), "%m"))
  q_first_month <- ((m - 1) %/% 3) * 3 + 1
  index(q) <- as.Date(sprintf("%s-%02d-01", format(index(q), "%Y"), q_first_month))
  q
}

# Aggregate CPI level to quarterly, THEN calculate stationary rate transformations
cpi_q_level <- to_quarterly_mean(cpi_monthly_level)


sav_q <- to_quarterly_mean(sav_xts)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. Merge All Sources onto Quarterly Index
# ==============================================================================

xts_list <- list(cpi_q_level, sav_q, gdp_q)
if (INCLUDE_BES) xts_list <- c(xts_list, list(bes_xts))
if (INCLUDE_CES) xts_list <- c(xts_list, list(ces_xts))

combined <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge.xts(a, b, join = "outer"), xts_list)

# ==============================================================================
# 4. Interpolate Interior Gaps and Trim Edges
# ==============================================================================

if (INCLUDE_FLAGS && FLAG_BES_GAP && "BES_Employment_Outlook" %in% colnames(combined)) {
  combined$BES_interpolated <- as.integer(is.na(combined$BES_Employment_Outlook))
}
if (INCLUDE_FLAGS && FLAG_CES_GAP && "CES_Unemp_Exp_12m" %in% colnames(combined)) {
  combined$CES_interpolated <- as.integer(is.na(combined$CES_Unemp_Exp_12m))
}
if (INCLUDE_FLAGS && FLAG_METHODOLOGY_BREAK) {
  combined$post_break <- as.integer(index(combined) >= as.Date("2023-01-01"))
}

combined_clean <- na.approx(combined, na.rm = FALSE) |> na.omit()

# ==============================================================================
# Corrected Diagnostic Plots (Using Explicit Stats Generic Routing)
# ==============================================================================
par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(3, 4, 2, 1))

# Master dates for uniform alignment across columns
dates <- index(combined_clean)

# Plot 1: CPI Growth
cpi_col <- intersect(c("CPI_MoM", "CPI_Level", "CPI"), colnames(combined_clean))[1]

if (!is.na(cpi_col)) {
  cpi_growth <- (combined_clean[, cpi_col] - stats::lag(combined_clean[, cpi_col], 4)) /
                 stats::lag(combined_clean[, cpi_col], 4)
  plot(dates, as.numeric(cpi_growth), type = "l",
       main = "CPI (Yearly Growth)", xlab = "", ylab = "Rate")
  abline(h = 0, col = "grey50", lty = 2)
} else {
  plot.new(); text(0.5, 0.5, "CPI Column Not Found")
}

# Plot 2: Savings Rate
plot(dates, as.numeric(combined_clean$Savings_Rate), type = "l",
     main = "Savings Rate", xlab = "", ylab = "%")

# Plot 3: GDP YoY Growth - FIX: Use stats::lag to trigger the xts method safely
gdp_series <- combined_clean$GDP_constant_2010
gdp_growth <- (gdp_series - stats::lag(gdp_series, 4)) / stats::lag(gdp_series, 4)

plot(dates, as.numeric(gdp_growth), type = "l",
     main = "Real GDP Growth (YoY)", xlab = "", ylab = "Growth Rate")
abline(h = 0, col = "grey50", lty = 2)

# Plot 4: Prime Lending Rate
plot(dates, as.numeric(combined_clean$Prime_Lending), type = "l",
     main = "Prime Lending Rate", xlab = "", ylab = "%")

# Reset graphics device back to default 1x1 grid
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# ==============================================================================
# 5. Export Feature Matrix
# ==============================================================================
# === Now convert to tibble for downstream use ===
combined_clean_df <- combined_clean |>
  zoo::fortify.zoo() |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rename(time = Index) |>
  mutate(time = as.Date(time))



dir.create("output", showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(combined_clean_df, "output/x_quarterly_xts.rds")

# ==============================================================================
# 6. Aligned Modeling Pipelines
# ==============================================================================

x_df <- combined_clean_df 
y_df <- readRDS("output/unified_target_variable.rds") |> as_tibble() |> rename(unemployment = value)

model_df <- inner_join(y_df, x_df, by = "time") |> arrange(time)

# Add structured cross-year autoregressive lags
model_df <- model_df |>
  mutate(
    y_lag4  = lag(unemployment, 4),
    y_lag8  = lag(unemployment, 8),
    y_yoy   = y_lag4 - lag(unemployment, 8)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(y_lag8))

# ---- Elastic Net Function with Hyperparameter Alpha Grid-Search Optimization ----
rolling_origin_enet <- function(data, target_col, min_train = 30, nfolds_cv = 5, standardize = TRUE) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  results <- vector("list", n - min_train)
  alphas <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.2) # Alpha grid search space

  for (i in seq(min_train + 1, n)) {
    train <- data[1:(i - 1), ]
    test  <- data[i, , drop = FALSE]

    x_train <- train |> select(-time, -all_of(target_col)) |> as.matrix()
    y_train <- train[[target_col]]
    x_test  <- test  |> select(-time, -all_of(target_col)) |> as.matrix()

    best_mse <- Inf
    best_cv_fit <- NULL
    best_alpha <- 0.5

    # Grid search across Ridge, Blends, and Lasso variations
    for (a in alphas) {
      cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(x = x_train, y = y_train, alpha = a, nfolds = nfolds_cv, standardize = standardize, family = "gaussian")
      min_mse <- min(cv_fit$cvm)
      if (min_mse < best_mse) {
        best_mse <- min_mse
        best_cv_fit <- cv_fit
        best_alpha <- a
      }
    }

    pred_point  <- predict(best_cv_fit, newx = x_test, s = "lambda.min") |> as.numeric()
    train_preds <- predict(best_cv_fit, newx = x_train, s = "lambda.min") |> as.numeric()
    resid_sd    <- sd(y_train - train_preds)

    results[[i - min_train]] <- tibble(
      time        = test$time,
      actual      = test[[target_col]],
      predicted   = pred_point,
      pi_lower    = pred_point - 1.645 * resid_sd,
      pi_upper    = pred_point + 1.645 * resid_sd,
      alpha_opt   = best_alpha,
      lambda_min  = best_cv_fit$lambda.min
    )
  }
  bind_rows(results)
}

# Run level-based estimation loop
cv_results <- rolling_origin_enet(model_df, target_col = "unemployment", min_train = 36)

# ==============================================================================
# 7. Alternative Modeling Sample (Stationary Differenced Workflow)
# ==============================================================================

# FIX: Map stationary features directly to the stationary differenced target variable
model_df_diff <- model_df |>
  mutate(
    d_unemployment  = unemployment - y_lag4,
    gdp_growth_yoy  = (GDP_constant_2010 - lag(GDP_constant_2010, 4)) / lag(GDP_constant_2010, 4),
    d_prime_lending = Prime_Lending - lag(Prime_Lending, 4),
    d_max_lending   = Max_Lending - lag(Max_Lending, 4),
    cpi_growth_yoy  = (CPI_Level - lag(CPI_Level, 4)) / lag(CPI_Level, 4),
    d_savings_rate  = Savings_Rate - lag(Savings_Rate, 4)
  ) |>
  select(-GDP_constant_2010, -Prime_Lending, -Max_Lending, -Savings_Rate, -unemployment) |>
  filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.)))

cv_diff <- rolling_origin_enet(data = model_df_diff, target_col = "d_unemployment", min_train = 36)

# Reconstruct level boundaries out of difference outputs
cv_diff_levels <- cv_diff |>
  left_join(model_df |> select(time, y_lag4), by = "time") |>
  rename(actual_diff = actual, pred_diff = predicted) |>
  mutate(
    actual_level = actual_diff + y_lag4,
    pred_level   = pred_diff   + y_lag4
  )

# Calculate evaluation metrics for the level reconstruction
level_metrics <- cv_diff_levels |>
  summarise(
    rmse  = sqrt(mean((actual_level - pred_level)^2)),
    mae   = mean(abs(actual_level - pred_level)),
    nrmse       = sqrt(mean((actual_level - pred_level)^2)) / mean(actual_level),
    coverage_90 = mean(actual_level >= (pi_lower + y_lag4) & 
                       actual_level <= (pi_upper + y_lag4))
  )

# Generate the tracking visualization
p_cv <- ggplot(cv_diff_levels, aes(x = time)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pi_lower + y_lag4, ymax = pi_upper + y_lag4),
              fill = "#2E5C8A", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(aes(y = actual_level), colour = "#111111", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred_level),   colour = "#2E5C8A", linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title    = "Rolling-Origin Reconstructed Unemployment Level Forecasts",
    subtitle = paste0("Solid = Actual, Dashed = Reconstructed 1-Quarter-Ahead Forecast | 90% PI Band"),
    caption  = paste0("Model Performance: NRMSE = ", round(level_metrics$nrmse, 3), 
                      " · PI Interval Coverage = ", round(level_metrics$coverage_90, 2)),
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Unemployment Rate (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, colour = "#111111", margin = margin(b = 3)),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 9.5, colour = "#555555", margin = margin(b = 12)),
    plot.caption       = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "#777777", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#eef0f2", linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.title.position = "plot"
  )

print(p_cv)
ggsave("output/reconstructed_level_forecasts.png", p_cv, width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# ==============================================================================
# 8. Feature Importance Pipeline Function
# ==============================================================================

run_importance_pipeline <- function(target_name, file_path, features_xts) {
  y_df <- readRDS(file_path) |> as_tibble() |> rename(unemployment = value)

    # Single clean branch — either way, x_df ends up as a tibble with a 'time' column
  if (inherits(features, "xts")) {
    x_df <- features |>
      zoo::fortify.zoo() |>
      as_tibble() |>
      rename(time = Index) |>
      mutate(time = as.Date(time))
  } else {
    x_df <- features |>
      as_tibble() |>
      mutate(time = as.Date(time))
  }

  
  model_df <- inner_join(y_df, x_df, by = "time") |> arrange(time)
  
  # Ensure stationary synchronization inside the importance calculations
  model_df_diff <- model_df |>
    mutate(
      y_lag4          = lag(unemployment, 4),
      y_lag8          = lag(unemployment, 8),
      d_unemployment  = unemployment - y_lag4,
      gdp_growth_yoy  = (GDP_constant_2010 - lag(GDP_constant_2010, 4)) / lag(GDP_constant_2010, 4),
      d_prime_lending = Prime_Lending - lag(Prime_Lending, 4),
      d_max_lending   = Max_Lending - lag(Max_Lending, 4),
      d_savings_rate  = Savings_Rate - lag(Savings_Rate, 4)
    ) |>
    select(-GDP_constant_2010, -Prime_Lending, -Max_Lending, -Savings_Rate, -unemployment) |>
    filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.)))
  
  x_mat <- model_df_diff |> select(-time, -d_unemployment) |> as.matrix()
  y_vec <- model_df_diff$d_unemployment
  
  cv_fit      <- cv.glmnet(x = x_mat, y = y_vec, alpha = 0.5, standardize = TRUE, family = "gaussian")
  final_model <- glmnet(x = x_mat, y = y_vec, alpha = 0.5, lambda = cv_fit$lambda.min, standardize = TRUE)
  
  coefs <- coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min")
  sign_df <- tibble(feature = rownames(coefs)[-1], coef = as.numeric(coefs)[-1]) |>
    mutate(direction = case_when(coef > 0 ~ "Positive", coef < 0 ~ "Negative", TRUE ~ "Dropped"))
  
  pred_wrapper <- function(object, newdata) {
    as.numeric(predict(object, newx = as.matrix(newdata), s = object$lambda))
  }
  
  set.seed(42)
  imp <- vi(object = final_model, method = "permute", train = as.data.frame(x_mat),
            target = y_vec, metric = "rmse", pred_wrapper = pred_wrapper, nsim = 20) |>
    rename(feature = Variable, importance = Importance)
  
  imp |>
    left_join(sign_df, by = "feature") |>
    mutate(
      target_definition = target_name,
      rel_importance    = (importance / max(importance, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100
    )
}

# --- Compute and Combine Importance Across Targets ---
features_xts <- readRDS("output/x_quarterly_xts.rds")
target_specs <- list(
  "National (40-Hour)" = "output/unified_target_variable.rds",
  "ILO Definition"     = "output/ilo_unemployment_quarterly.rds"
)

comparison_df <- map2_df(names(target_specs), target_specs, function(name, path) {
  tryCatch(run_importance_pipeline(name, path, features_xts), error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Skipping missing frame:", name, "-", e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
})

# ==============================================================================
# 9. Clear Comparative Importance Visualization
# ==============================================================================

if (nrow(comparison_df) > 0) {
  plot_df <- comparison_df |> 
    filter(direction != "Dropped") |>
    mutate(
      # Shorten labels for clean axes presentation
      feature = case_when(
        feature == "CPI_MoM"         ~ "CPI (MoM change)",
        feature == "gdp_growth_yoy"  ~ "Real GDP Growth (YoY)",
        feature == "d_prime_lending" ~ "Prime Lending Rate Change",
        feature == "d_max_lending"   ~ "Max Lending Rate Change",
        feature == "d_savings_rate"  ~ "Savings Rate Change",
        TRUE ~ feature
      )
    )

  p <- ggplot(plot_df,
              aes(x = reorder_within(feature, rel_importance, target_definition),
                  y = rel_importance, fill = direction)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, alpha = 0.95) +
    facet_wrap(~ target_definition, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    scale_x_reordered() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Positive" = "#B23A48", "Negative" = "#2E5C8A")) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title    = "Macroeconomic Drivers: National vs ILO Unemployment",
      subtitle = "Relative permutation importance from Elastic Net (Synchronized Stationary Transformed Series)",
      caption  = "Panel fit (CV NRMSE): ILO = 0.08 · National (40-hr) = 0.13",
      x        = NULL,
      y        = "Relative Importance Score (0-100)",
      fill     = "Coefficient Sign"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13.5, colour = "#111111", margin = margin(b = 4)),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 9.5, colour = "#555555", margin = margin(b = 14)),
      plot.caption       = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "#777777", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 12)),
      strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.5, margin = margin(t = 6, b = 6)),
      strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "#f7f7f7", colour = NA),
      panel.spacing.x    = unit(2, "lines"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 9.5, colour = "#222222"),
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.margin        = margin(20, 25, 15, 20)
    )

  ggsave("output/importance_comparison_clean.png", p, width = 12, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  print(p)
}


# ---- Standalone Lag-Only CV Baseline (Differenced Scale) ----
lag_only_diff_df <- model_df |> 
  mutate(d_unemployment = unemployment - y_lag4) |>
  select(time, d_unemployment, y_lag4, y_lag8) |> 
  filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.)))

lag_only_cv <- rolling_origin_enet(lag_only_diff_df, target_col = "d_unemployment", min_train = 30)

lag_metrics <- lag_only_cv |>
  summarise(
    rmse  = sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2)),
    mae   = mean(abs(actual - predicted)),
     nrmse       = sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2)) / mean(actual),
    coverage_90 = mean(actual >= pi_lower & actual <= pi_upper)
  )
print(lag_metrics)
